summary: Phase A (Categories & Requests) fully validated. Backend: 12/12 pytest cases pass — per-category commission admin endpoint (200/400/404/no-token), mission budget persistence, end-to-end booking with commission_pct=10.0 and jobby_fee = labor * 10% for pulizie, business detail (price_list + 404), and business-request budget storage. Pulizie commission reset to 10.0 at end as required. Frontend (Expo web, mobile viewport 390x844, CLIENT token): richieste tab shows filter-all/filter-active/filter-completed chips + sort-toggle, all tappable without crash and merged list renders (missions, biz requests, bookings) with 'Budget: €X' badges shown. /request/pulizie?type=service renders budget-input (single-page form with location/date/budget) — filled '80' successfully. /business-request/user_2f996c8a010a?cat=lavanderia shows biz-price-0 (Camicia €2.50), biz-price-1 (Pantalone €1.80), breq-note, and breq-budget input — filled '50' successfully.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Non-blocking on Expo web but should migrate to boxShadow for RN 0.76+/react-native-web compatibility. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme.ts (shadow.card)
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.' Non-blocking, but should be migrated.

action_items: Optional cleanup: migrate 'shadow*' style props to 'boxShadow' (RN 0.76+ deprecation).

Note (docs): frontend auth token is stored as JSON.stringify(token) in localStorage — test agents should set 'jobby_session_token' with a JSON-encoded string (e.g. `JSON.stringify('demo-preview-token-123')`), not a raw string. This is expected behavior of storage-base.retrieve().
critical_code_review_comments: missions.py select_provider correctly reads category.commission_pct with 10.0 fallback and persists commission_pct+jobby_fee on the booking doc.
catalog.seed_categories() sets commission_pct=10.0 via $setOnInsert AND has an update_many migration to backfill legacy docs — good defensive coding.
admin_set_commission validates 0<=pct<=100 and returns invalid_pct/Not found appropriately.
business_detail returns 404 with 'business_not_found' detail as required; excludes MongoDB _id.
seed_data_creation: One TEST_ mission (pulizie, budget=80) + one business-request (lavanderia, budget=50) created via CLIENT token during pytest run. Auto-accepted by bots and converted to a booking; verified booking.commission_pct=10.0 and jobby_fee=labor*0.10.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend auth: set localStorage['jobby_session_token'] = JSON.stringify('demo-preview-token-123'). All Phase A testIDs are in place: filter-all/filter-active/filter-completed, sort-toggle, budget-input, biz-price-{i}, breq-budget, breq-note. Business user_2f996c8a010a currently has 2 price_list items (Camicia, Pantalone) and services=[pulizie, tecnico, lavanderia]. Pulizie commission is 10.0 (reset by test).
rca_of_issue: No open bugs. Only observation: on the first UI probe attempt the token was set as a raw string, causing a JSON.parse warning and 401s. This was a test-harness error, not an app bug — after setting JSON.stringify('demo-preview-token-123') all authenticated flows worked.
